QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Pack Up, and Set Sail 2
QuestInfo.0: Leon asked you to gather supplies from the General Store while he put together a crew.
QuestInfo.1: Leon asked you to gather supplies from the General Store while he put together a crew. You went to pick up the items.
QuestInfo.2: Leon asked you to gather supplies from the General Store while he put together a crew. You went to pick up the items, but were overwhelmed by all the stuff. The guys at the store said they were told to deliver the stuff straight to the harbor, and then you ran into the Robed Lady...

0.0: I've got it in my head now. The bodacious crew to compliment our seafaring adventure. I'm gonna go get them together, and you go get all the supplies, okay?

no.0: But, I'm the hero... I don't get the supplies.

npc.0: Head over to the #bGeneral Store#k and tell them I sent you. They know my dad, so they'll give you everything for free.
